script_approved: 2026-09-26 founder: 'i like the script' (reel_scripts/manali__not_this_time.json); passes script_gate against reel-data.json (Spiti Valley November = skip, Manali November = go, Spiti October = go).
method: KEYFRAME-FIRST, same as triund__first_trek_kf: refs, then a free Nano Banana still per beat composed from the refs, then Frames to Video on Veo 3.1 Lite from each still. Motion + sound prompts only; the stills carry the look.
setting_basis: The footage shows an ordinary home bedroom, then a generic wooden guesthouse balcony and a quiet lane among deodar trees in a Himalayan valley. It makes no claim about Spiti weather or roads; the script's only facts are the month verdicts.
look: Soft natural morning light, cool mountain air, natural colour, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, photorealistic, cinematic. Faces are never in close-up and no one looks at the camera. A phone screen is only a soft glow, never legible. No other people. No music, no speech, no voiceover, no text, captions, logos or watermark.

refs.prompt: Full-length photograph of a woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a mustard yellow knitted sweater, blue jeans and white sneakers, standing indoors in soft window light, three-quarter view, neutral expression, photorealistic, natural light, no text.

refs.name: ref_man
refs.prompt: Full-length photograph of a man in his late twenties with short black hair and light stubble, wearing a navy blue hooded jacket, grey trousers and brown boots, standing indoors in soft window light, three-quarter view, neutral expression, photorealistic, natural light, no text.

refs.name: ref_valley
refs.prompt: A wooden guesthouse balcony in a Himalayan valley in soft early morning light, tall deodar trees on the slopes, distant mountains with a little snow on the highest peaks, thin mist, photorealistic, no people, no text.

keyframes.name: kf_s1
keyframes.prompt: Medium shot in a small city apartment bedroom in soft morning window light: the woman in the mustard yellow sweater kneels beside a half-packed backpack on the floor, folding a woollen jacket into it; the man in the navy hooded jacket sits on the bed behind her holding a map, smiling.

keyframes.name: kf_s2
keyframes.prompt: Same bedroom, same two people and the same light as the reference, moments later: the woman sits back on her heels holding her phone, its screen only a soft glow, her face falling slightly as she reads; the man leans forward to look.

keyframes.name: kf_s3
keyframes.prompt: Same bedroom, same two people and the same light as the reference: the man sits on the floor beside her and they both look at the phone together, she is nodding slowly, a small accepting smile, the backpack between them.
keyframes.tone: gentle acceptance, a decision made together

keyframes.name: kf_s4
keyframes.prompt: Medium shot from the side on the wooden guesthouse balcony in soft early morning light: the woman in the mustard yellow sweater with a grey shawl round her shoulders holds a steaming glass of chai in both hands, deodar trees and misty mountains behind her.

keyframes.name: kf_s5
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot from behind on the wooden balcony: the woman with the grey shawl and the man in the navy hooded jacket stand side by side at the railing holding chai, looking out at the deodar slopes and the distant mountains in thin morning mist.

keyframes.name: kf_s6
keyframes.prompt: Wide shot from behind: the woman in the mustard yellow sweater and grey shawl and the man in the navy hooded jacket walk slowly side by side down a quiet lane between tall deodar trees in soft morning light, mountains in the distance.

en:
I wanted Spiti.
We'd saved the trip all year.
Bags were half packed.

Then I checked NakshIQ.
Spiti.
November.
Skip.

So we changed the plan.
Manali instead.

One quiet morning.
Cold air.
Hot chai in my hands.

And I knew we'd made the right call.
Spiti wasn't cancelled.
It was waiting.

Because travel intelligence is knowing the right place, at the right time.
NakshIQ.
hi:
मुझे स्पीति जाना था।
पूरे साल इस ट्रिप का इंतज़ार किया था।
बैग आधे पैक हो चुके थे।

फिर मैंने NakshIQ चेक किया।
स्पीति।
नवंबर।
स्किप।

तो हमने प्लान बदल दिया।
मनाली चले गए।

एक शांत सुबह।
ठंडी हवा।
हाथ में गरम चाय।

और लगा, हमने सही फ़ैसला लिया।
स्पीति कैंसल नहीं हुई थी।
वो बस इंतज़ार कर रही थी।

क्योंकि ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस यानी सही जगह, सही समय पर।
NakshIQ.
